description: This file defines the 'ParamRuleCollection' class within the 'OrangeHRM' project, specifically in the 'Validator' submodule of the API version 2. plugin, managing collections of parameter validation rules, including handling exclusions and strictness settings.

classes.name: ParamRuleCollection
classes.description: A class managing a collection of parameter validation rules, with functionalities to add, remove, and retrieve validation rules and manage exclusions and strictness flags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection with optional ParamRule objects.

methods.name: getParamValidations
methods.description: Returns an array of all ParamRule validation objects currently in the collection.

methods.name: setParamValidations
methods.description: Sets multiple ParamRule validation objects, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: addParamValidation
methods.description: Adds a single ParamRule validation to the collection, throws exception if a validation for the same param key already exists.

methods.name: removeParamValidation
methods.description: Removes a ParamRule validation by param key, returning it if it exists.

methods.name: isStrict
methods.description: Returns whether the collection is in strict mode.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of param keys to ParamRule objects.

methods.name: getExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the list of parameter keys that are excluded.

methods.name: setExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Sets the list of excluded parameter keys.

methods.name: addExcludedParamKey
methods.description: Adds a single key to the list of excluded parameter keys.
